extracted.name: Mango chutney & chicken sliders
extracted.description: Top these chicken sliders with mango chutney, red onion, chilli and cucumber salad, and a mint & yogurt dressing. They make fabulous finger food for summer
ingredient_lines: ½ small bunch mint leaves picked and finely chopped
1 small red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
½ small bunch coriander finely chopped
instruction_lines: Mix the yogurt, mayonnaise and mint together in a small bowl, then season and set aside. Combine the red onion, chilli, cucumber and coriander in a separate bowl.

Slice and shred the chicken (keep the bones for stock). Serve with the yogurt sauce, onion and cucumber salad, lettuce, mango chutney and wholemeal rolls for making sliders, and eat any extra chicken with the salad on the side.
